phases.objective: Re-read bounded exact-head review decisions, then perform a final open/Draft/head/base identity readback immediately before merge and expose only the final validated approval evidence in merge audit output.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: PUT /pulls/{number}/merge is reachable only when the final bounded review readback proves the required exact-head non-author human approval quorum and the subsequent final identity readback still proves an open non-Draft PR with unchanged head and base.
steps: Validate CI, freshness, Draft state, and exact head/base identity.
Read and validate initial bounded exact-head approval evidence.
Re-read open/Draft/head/base identity after initial approval evidence.
Re-read the bounded review set and recompute approval quorum immediately before merge.
Re-read open/Draft/head/base identity after final review evidence and immediately before PUT /merge.
Return only final approval evidence in merge audit output.
assertions: Approval dismissal after initial validation blocks merge.
A newly active exact-head CHANGES_REQUESTED decision blocks merge.
Reviewer replacement, stale substitution, or quorum loss blocks merge.
Unchanged final approval evidence remains bound to expected_head_sha.
Initial or final unbounded review evidence blocks merge.
All final review-state failures report validation_phase=final_pre_merge_review_readback and do not call the merge endpoint.
State, Draft, head, or base drift after final review evidence fails with validation_phase=final_pre_merge_identity_readback and does not call the merge endpoint.

phases.objective: Prove active main ruleset review enforcement and non-bypass finalizer identity before protected merge.
Prove equivalent policy across merge queue and auto-merge paths.
Repository lifecycle finalization has no provider canary authority.
This guard grants no Production, deployment, provider, database, migration, credential, or external-send authority.
